description: Look up one US regulated facility by its EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) Registry ID. Returns ONE unified profile across all EPA programs the facility belongs to — Clean Air Act (CAA), Clean Water Act/NPDES (CWA), Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), hazardous waste (RCRA), Toxics Release Inventory (TRI), and Greenhouse Gas (GHG) — with address and county, current compliance status, inspection and enforcement history, penalties, and per-program detail. Data is EPA ECHO. This is screening data, not a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment.
name: get_facility
